analysis.narrativeEn:

· High position relative to SMA100/200 ($287.66/$210.15): Maintains mid-to-long term trend strength.

· MACD histogram trajectory (1.0073→10.8626): Continues strong expansion, signaling trend strengthening.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near upper band $323.06): Approaching upper band, bandwidth at 46.12% shows expansion.

· Swing resistance ($427.99): Potential for further upside upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low pattern (Recovery after Higher Low formation): Signals strengthening uptrend.

· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend): Buy entry conditions met, high probability of trend continuation.
